verdict.rationale: React is a JavaScript UI library used entirely through code; it has no separate end-user product interface or dashboard whose actions an API would need to mirror. UI-versus-API parity is therefore the wrong axis for this kind of product. The OpenAPI probe returning 404 does not change that, since the question itself does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
